svg.title: Figure 1 · What is in the geometry file
svg.desc: Meshes, vertices and triangles per part class, and the buffer layout
svg.text: Figure 1 · What is in the geometry file
sus-m1.js: 514 meshes (209 in the standing pose, the rest a frame's own shape), 160,649 vertices and 254,878 triangles in 16 part classes; positions are int16 on a 0.3 mm
grid about [0.0, 0.0, 2.3] m. Read from the file's own mesh table.
Binary buffer 2,911 KB, carried as base64 (3,882 KB) after the 135 KB mesh table: 4,017 KB in all, one <script> file so a page opened from a local checkout can load it.

Generated by tools/figures/assets3d_readme.py from the mesh table in the geometry file. CL-05 concept geometry for review, not a design: posed by concept kinematics, with no dynamics, balance or load model.

g.text: Terms: CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · KB = kilobyte, a file size of 1,024 bytes
